description: Automatically surface unexpected spending spikes by comparing current month spend against rolling 3-month averages. Hot spots panel on dashboard, drill-down into driving transactions, and a weekly LLM-generated narrative digest. This is the 'catch what you'd otherwise miss' feature.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 4 complete — budget periods and rolling averages computed.

principles: Anomalies should surface without Eric looking for them — push, don't pull
False positives destroy trust — threshold must be tunable
LLM narratives add color but raw data must always be accessible behind them

SECRETS INVARIANT — LLM prompts receive only derived/aggregated financial data (category names, amounts, date ranges, first names). Never access tokens, account numbers, .env values, or items table secrets. Enforced by secrets-guard module and test coverage.

techStack.testing: Jest for detection logic, fixture data sets for threshold testing

userStories.title: Anomaly detection engine
acceptanceCriteria: Compute: current month spend per category vs. 3-month rolling average
Flag anomaly when current spend > 130% of rolling average
Anomaly record: category_id, current_amount, average_amount, delta_percentage, period, detected_at
Detection runs daily (post-sync job) and on-demand via admin
Categories with <3 months history excluded from anomaly detection
Small-dollar categories (average < $25/mo) excluded to avoid noise
Detection is idempotent — same anomaly not re-created if already exists for current period
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests with fixture data: normal spending (no anomaly), 130% spike (anomaly), 129% (no anomaly), small-dollar exclusion, insufficient history. Idempotency test.

userStories.title: Hot spots dashboard panel
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard panel showing top 3-5 unacknowledged anomalies
Each anomaly displays: category name, dollar delta, percentage over average
Visual treatment: red/orange alert styling, distinct from budget cards
Click anomaly to drill into transactions driving the spike
Panel hidden when no anomalies exist (clean dashboard state)
Position: above budget cards for visibility
userStories.testStrategy: UI test: panel renders with anomalies, hides when none. Drill-down link verification.

userStories.title: Anomaly drill-down and acknowledge
acceptanceCriteria: Drill-down view shows all transactions in the anomalous category for current month
Comparison: this month's transactions vs. typical month (count and total)
Acknowledge button: marks anomaly as reviewed with optional note
Dismissed anomalies no longer appear in hot spots panel
History view of past acknowledged anomalies (admin)
userStories.testStrategy: Acknowledge API test. History persistence test. UI test for drill-down transaction list.

userStories.title: Weekly anomaly digest (LLM narrative)
acceptanceCriteria: Background job runs Sunday evening (configurable via cron)
Collects current anomalies + week's spending summary
Sends structured prompt to OpenAI API (gpt-5-nano) with financial data context
LLM generates plain-English narrative: what spiked, possible reasons, one recommendation
Narrative cached in magic_actions_log (type='weekly_digest', prompt_hash for dedup)
Digest viewable on dashboard — latest digest displayed in dedicated panel
LLM prompt does NOT include account numbers, access tokens, or PII beyond first names
userStories.testStrategy: Unit test for prompt construction (verify no sensitive data). Mock LLM response test. Caching/dedup test. Integration test with OpenAI API (manual, sandbox).

high: LLM prompt must not leak secrets — all prompts pass through secrets-guard sanitization before API call. Test suite validates no access tokens, account numbers, or .env values appear in constructed prompts.
medium: 130% threshold may be too sensitive or too loose depending on category — consider per-category thresholds later
OpenAI API availability/cost — cache aggressively, degrade gracefully if API unavailable
low: Anomaly detection on imported Monarch data may flag historical months — decide if backfill detection is desired

preFlightChecklist: Confirm OpenAI API key and gpt-5-nano model availability
Decide: anomaly detection on historical months (Monarch data) or current month only?
Decide: 130% threshold global or per-category configurable?
Decide: small-dollar exclusion threshold ($25/mo suggested — confirm)
